name: Ashcombe's Sealed Note
description: A note Professor Ashcombe left with McGonagall, to be given to Gloria on her arrival.
documentBody:
Ms. Spellen. If you are reading this, I have either become very dramatic in old age or very correct. I hope for the former.

I require someone who can discover a thing and still ask whether discovery makes it true. More importantly, I require someone who can discover she was wrong and say so. If you've come this far, I believe you'll know where to begin.

A ribbon marks one page of the notebook that comes with this note.

**Some Questions Are Inherited.**

Begin where everyone else stopped looking.

name: Ashcombe's Working Notebook
description: Professor Ashcombe's research notebook, entrusted to Gloria by McGonagall.

name: Ancient Eagle Fragment
description: A weathered eagle carving found in Ashcombe's office, unlike the modern Ravenclaw emblem but sharing important anatomy.

name: Photograph of Four Friends
description: A moving photograph of a younger Ashcombe with Gideon, Elspeth, and Benedict, laughing together. Ashcombe isn't looking at the camera — he's looking at the people.

name: Pensieve Vial A
description: A memory vial sealed with a personal ward. It cannot be opened yet.

name: Ashcombe's Notes About Gloria
description: Three small cards among Ashcombe's papers, each referring to Gloria by name.
documentBody:
**G. SPELLEN — STILL THE BEST CANDIDATE.**

**SPELLEN — RAVENCLAW. IRRELEVANT. METHOD MATTERS.**

**SHE CHANGED HER ANSWER.**

name: Broken Clasp
description: A metal clasp recovered from the fallen stone at the Founder relief.

name: Fracture Site Photographs
description: Documentation of the fracture lines at the collapsed Founder relief.

name: Magical Residue Analysis
description: Faint magical residue recovered at the point of impact — spellwork struck the stone exactly where the fatal fracture starts.
